recentItems.title: What Germany gets wrong about Native Americans
recentItems.description:
Germany has a surprising passion: America's Indigenous peoples. For generations, people here have been fascinated by Indigenous cultures and a romanticized version of the Wild West. Every summer, hundreds of thousands even celebrate a fictional Indigenous hero dreamed up by a German author. But for Native Americans, such images can be painful — a fascination caught between admiration, stereotypes, and cultural appropriation.
